# ADR-3244: AWS s3: Bucket policy principal star for bucket 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Principal * opens anonymous access paths.

## Decision

Policies MUST NOT use a bucket policy principal star for bucket 4 (AWS-s3-4) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Principals are account or service scoped.
